gr_in_001.speaker: greeter
gr_in_001.text: Haven't seen you before. I'm Mara — I keep an eye on the square. (This whole conversation is an example. Open npcs/dialogues/greeter.json to see how it's built.)

choices.text: Anything I can do around here?
[Speech 40] You look like you could use a friend.

gr_in_quest.speaker: greeter
gr_in_quest.text: There's a supply crate by the east wall — was meant for the fountain repair. Crack it open and bring me what's inside, would you?

gr_in_charm_pass.speaker: greeter
gr_in_charm_pass.text: Heh. Smooth. All right, stranger — you've got a friend in the square.

gr_in_charm_fail.speaker: greeter
gr_in_charm_fail.text: ...Sure. Let's not get ahead of ourselves.

gr_ret_001.speaker: greeter
gr_ret_001.text: Back again. The square's quiet today.

choices.text: I opened that crate — here's what was inside.

gr_ret_thanks.speaker: greeter
gr_ret_thanks.text: Bless you. The fountain'll run again yet. Here — take this for your trouble.
